name: Free AI Lead Capture and Score Workflow

parameters.content:
Free AI Lead Capture and Score Workflow

Use this before sending a paid offer. It collects lead pain, budget, urgency, and source, then segments the lead into hot, warm, or cold.

Ethical use: do not scrape or spam. Connect this to a form or opted-in inquiry source.

Lead scoring logic

Hot lead: strong revenue pain, tool-cost pain, enough budget, and urgent timing.
Warm/cold lead: send proof or a lighter qualifying question before pitching.

Next-step routing

Hot leads get the paid-offer path.
Warm/cold leads get education, proof, or one qualifying question.

Replace the URLs with your own offer and proof pages.
